# Acendio — AI & Digital Growth Agency

> Tagline: Ascend With AI-Powered Growth.
> Primary Objective: Generating qualified inbound appointments and custom growth systems for local and growing businesses across [TARGET REGIONS].

## Overview
Acendio is an AI and digital growth agency headquartered in [LOCATION]. We engineer connected acquisition and retention infrastructure: conversion-focused websites, 24/7 AI voice and SMS receptionists, Meta and Google Ads management, automated Google review workflows, CRM speed-to-lead pipelines, AI support chat, and custom software integrations.

## Core Services
- [Website Development, Deployment & Maintenance](https://[DOMAIN]/services/website-development-maintenance): Fast, mobile-first websites engineered for search visibility and conversion, backed by ongoing security updates, backups, uptime monitoring, and performance tuning.
- [AI Receptionist](https://[DOMAIN]/services/ai-receptionist): 24/7 voice and SMS receptionist that answers inbound calls, qualifies prospects, books calendar appointments, recovers missed calls via text-back, and logs every interaction in the CRM.
- [Ads Management & Ad Creatives](https://[DOMAIN]/services/ads-management-creatives): Full-funnel Meta and Google Ads campaign strategy, tracking, retargeting, static and video ad creative design, and A/B testing.
- [Review Management & Automation](https://[DOMAIN]/services/review-management-automation): Automated post-service SMS and email review requests, sentiment routing, AI-assisted review replies, and Google Business Profile growth.
- [CRM & Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://[DOMAIN]/services/crm-lead-follow-up-automation): GoHighLevel pipeline architecture, instant speed-to-lead, multi-channel nurture sequences, lead reactivation, and appointment reminders.
- [AI Chat & Support](https://[DOMAIN]/services/ai-chat-support): Website and social chat agents trained on verified company FAQs for 24/7 lead capture and clean human handoff.
- [Custom Software & AI Automation](https://[DOMAIN]/services/custom-software-ai-automation): Bespoke internal tools, operational dashboards, API bridges, and LLM workflows tailored to business operations.
